scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-parameter statement is proven by signed integral cellular boundaries; finite modular computations are only checks. No external independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Ko–Park previously determined the nonequivariant Betti rank; An–Knudsen previously exhibited non-toric classes for a different graph. The new assertion is the explicit integral symmetry module and full chain-coordinate classification for the unbalanced fan-graph family. Indexed searches do not certify publication priority; the 2026 stable-representation preprint was accessible only at abstract level.
title: Integral non-toric two-particle homology of \(K_{1,2,t}\)
